# Tests

This layer contains test files for various aspects of the software project, including action steps, check runs, comments, configuration, coverage, documentation, end-to-end tests, edges, first run, git repository, heavy level, helpers, ignore patterns, mock Ollama, models, and test files.

## Overview

This folder contains test files for various components of the app, including in-memory mock objects and test functions for the PKCS#1 to PKCS#8 conversion, scheduler, setup, and webhook functionalities.

## Responsibilities

- **Check Runs**: Tests for the check run functionalities.
- **First Run**: Tests for the initial setup and configuration.

## How it works

For example, the `app/tests` folder includes tests for PKCS#1 to PKCS#8 conversion, scheduler, setup, and webhook functionalities.

## Configuration

- Environment variables: `DOCTURNAL_SLOW_TESTS`, `GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL`, `OLLAMA_HOST`, `OLLAMA_VERSION`, `SETTINGS`.
- Action inputs: `backlog-batch-size`, `comment-level`, `context-tokens`, `docs-dir`, `docs-model`, `exclude`, `existing-code`, `extensions`, `job-timeout-minutes`, `model`, `path`, `time-budget-minutes`.
- Configuration files: `.github/workflows/docturnal.yml`, `action.yml`, `app/tsconfig.json`, `app/wrangler.toml`, `pins/models.json`, `pins/ollama.json`.
